name: Curata
summary: A museum visitor desk with a live two-floor plan, timed entry, tickets, tours and members
about: A complete visitor management app for a museum or gallery, with sample data for a made-up museum on two floors. A live floor plan colours each room by how busy it is while visitor dots walk between galleries, and the desk sells timed-entry tickets, scans codes at the door and runs exhibitions, guided tours, members and reports.
how: Open Floor plan and switch between the ground and first floor; rooms warm up as visitor dots walk between them
Click or press Enter on a room for its live gauge and hourly chart, then close it, send a guide or change capacity
On Visitor desk, click a timed-entry slot to book it, or use the walk-up steppers to issue tickets
Type a ticket code like SH-40215 and press Check in; wrong, refunded or used codes show an inline error
Search and filter bookings, open one for its ticket code, then refund, resend or check it in
Edit exhibitions on the year timeline, add tours and places, assign guides and renew members
Switch 7D, 30D and 12M in Reports, change the theme or reset the demo data in Settings
